title: Context-Window Occupancy vs. Per-Token Separability — companion code, simulations and estimates
description: Companion package of a technical case study of nuFormer, the transaction foundation model of Braithwaite et al. (2025, arXiv:2507.23267), whose input is a fixed window of 2,048 tokens. Under a fluid Gaussian model with an optimal reader (assumptions (i)-(v) of docs/THEORY.md), with the window already saturated before the new source, adding a source whose per-token separability rho_s = d_s^2 / k_s is below the occupancy-weighted mean lowers the ceiling of the AUC of any reader of the same window. Ships the closed-form model with proofs, six pre-registered simulations (displacement replication over 720 cells, 200,000 users per cell, 5 seeds; literal token-budget test with event costs of 14 and 55 tokens; four follow-up families on the exponent of d, occupancy against rate weighting, event fusion and quotas), order-of-magnitude infrastructure estimates, a claims ledger and a SHA-256 provenance chain (run_all.py, make_provenance.py --verify). Code under Apache-2.0; text, figures and data under CC BY 4.0. Illustrative orders of magnitude; not a replication of nuFormer.
